title: "B camera" – U-2 B-camera reconnaissance system photo (Chapter 2, p. 54)
description: Dark black-and-white photograph captioned "B camera," showing a complex camera mechanism with lens barrel and mounting hardware, only faintly visible in the scan. The text notes that the B camera provided stereo coverage, was engineered by Hycon's chief designer William McFadden, and describes James Baker's proposed 240-inch focal-length C camera.
